nodes.procedure: First the FeO(OH) film with uniform nanopetals in the presence of glycerol was produced by a bio-inspired hydrothermal method.

nodes.name: FeO(OH) to FeP conversion
nodes.procedure: The FeO(OH) film was then transferred to Ti foil (electrode substrate), and heated at 80°C to enhance the contact between Ti foil and FeO(OH) film. Finally, the FeO(OH) films were converted to FeP films using PH3 as a phosphorous source.
